steps.speaker: Teenage Girl
steps.content: Ahhhh! I can't... I can't believe it!

steps.speaker: Teenage Girl
steps.content: The Dancing Lion! The one Daddy said he'd buy me.

steps.speaker: Teenage Girl
steps.content: Ah... and this one is...

steps.speaker: Teenage Girl
steps.content: A limited-edition EDGO set! I've always wanted this. If I have this case of building blocks, I'll be able to build a new castle in my bedroom.

steps.speaker: Teenage Girl
steps.content: Wait a second, is this real?

steps.speaker: Teenage Girl
steps.content: A Duck plushie! Also a limited edition. They made only 24 of these.

steps.speaker: Teenage Girl
steps.content: Ahh... Am I in heaven?

When you're on the other side of the wall, you find a teenage girl drowned in a sea of toys. She picks up one toy after another to examine, pinching her own cheek every now and again as if to make sure she's not dreaming.
So this is the true form of the ghost that has inspired so much dread, you think to yourself as you watch the overjoyed girl.
She's just a harmless girl who loves to play and cute toys.

steps.speaker: Toy-loving Girl
steps.content: Ah... hehe... Ducky plushie...
She doesn't notice your approach, too engrossed in her personal paradise. For all you know, you may have purchased all of the limited-edition toys in the entire shopping street.
You take her by the hand and pull her out of the mountain of toys.

options: I won. Now let's pick up where we left off.

steps.speaker: Toy-loving Girl
steps.content: Ehh? What?! Since.. Since when?

steps.speaker: Toy-loving Girl
steps.content: Oh no... does it mean... our game is already over...

steps.speaker: Toy-loving Girl
steps.content: But I... I haven't had enough fun yet.
She looks sad. She surely doesn't want the game to end so soon.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Listen, if you keep your word and tell me everything you know about that mysterious lady, I promise you I'll find time to play with you again.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Really?
Her eyes brighten up.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Fantastic! Of course I'll tell you what I know about her. I'm a person of my word. But you're not lying about playing with me again, are you?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Of course not.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Emm.. that's right!

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: She's a human, but she's also a pair of shears without self-control.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: It's not so hard to understand. She's a troubled person. You'll see that if you get a chance to observe her behavior.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: It's like she's trapped or entangled by something, kind of like... a compulsive obsession taking over?

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: She can't keep herself from cutting things. You don't find this behavior special?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Why is it that she doesn't attack you?

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Hehe, why don't you take a guess?
She blinks her bright eyes, waiting for your answer.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Bingo! No one can catch me in thick fog. Well, no one but you.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Sigh. Are you a dummy? She doesn't attack me, because she can't catch me.
Somehow, you don't feel that's the real reason.
According to the lantern girl, who is called Letta, Mad Shears attacks people burdened with worries and troubles.
And yet, she leaves Letta alone. Does that mean Letta is completely worry-free?
Very likely. The girl in front of you does look like she doesn't have a care in the world; she's now rubbing her cheek with a fluffy toy.
So if you're unburdened by any unpleasant thoughts, Mad Shears will leave you alone?
If that's the case, the residents getting trapped in thick fog can't be helpful.
Who wouldn't feel stressed and troubled if they were stuck in a foggy maze looking fruitlessly for an exit?

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Ahem, I'm telling you all this, not because you caught me.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: It's because I had a good time thanks to you. I can't remember the last time I had so much fun.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Oh! I'm taking this one with me by the way.
She snatches up the limited-edition Duck plushie, the most expensive in that pile of toys.
You reach out to stop her from leaving. She vanishes with a flash of light, and then reappears.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: I had a really good time today. See you!
Who would've thought the much-dreaded Lantern Ghost of Sloane Street is a teenage girl with a weakness for wind-up toys and stuffed animals?

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Oh, one more thing...
The girl seems to have remembered something important. She glides over to stand in front of you.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Make sure you never, ever, ever go up up that bell tower! No matter what.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Understood?

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Sigh. I knew I'd be wasting my breath.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Even If I were to tell you that "Ah! it's extremely dangerous, please don't go! It's even more dangerous than the Fog Alley!"

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: You'd still go there, wouldn't you?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: And I have my reasons.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Sigh. I knew you'd say that.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: If you're ever in trouble, look for the light.
She's harmless, you're now sure. She's just a teenage girl looking for someone to play with...
Even though the way she does it can be problematic.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Oh wait, what time is it now?
The girl tenses up visibly.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Oh no! My dad is coming home at ten. I'm gonna be in a lot of trouble if he comes home and I'm not in. I've got to go now!

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Promise me that you will remember! I just found a great playmate, I don't want to lose you.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: And don't forget that you said you'll play games with me again!
The girl lets out a long sigh when she's done talking and transforms into a black mass that blends in with the night.
